verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs present components as its core building block and Signals as its reactive state model. Independent production reports confirm truly reusable, encapsulated components composed via @Input/@Output into apps of 20-60 components. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of component encapsulation and composition APIs, explicit evidence that Signals manage component-local state.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build encapsulated components that manage their own local state and compose them into complex UIs

citations.quote: Opinionated & versatile, organized yet modular thanks to Angular components and dependency injection
Reactive and fast state updates with fine-grained reactivity based on Angular Signals
